ILLUSTRATIONS.TITLE: ILUSTRATIONS
ILLUSTRATIONS.SUBTITLE: Custom illustrations of your guests live for weddings and events
ILLUSTRATIONS.SUBTITLE_PAGE: Custom illustrations handmade in watercolor of your guests

BLOCK1.TITLE: ENJOY A UNIQUE EXPERIENCE
BLOCK1.SUBTITLE: An original gift to surprise your guests
BLOCK1.TEXT1: Imagine your guests receiving a portrait made especially for them. During the celebration, we draw live and turn that moment into an experience they can take with them.
BLOCK1.TEXT2: Each illustration is created with dedication, paying attention to the small details to create a unique piece, full of personality and with which to relive a special day.

BLOCK2.TITLE: WE GIVE VALUE TO THE DETAILS
BLOCK2.SUBTITLE: Much more than just an illustration
BLOCK2.TEXT1: An artistic experience designed to surprise, excite, and preserve.

ILLUSTRATIONS.CARD1-TEXT: Live art or live painting is a service where we illustrate the attendees of an event at the same time. Different techniques can be used such as watercolor or digital illustration.
ILLUSTRATIONS.CARD2-TEXT: To work properly, we need a long table (if possible) with two chairs. This should be in a very bright place and if it's outdoors, the table should be in the shade with an accessible power outlet.
ILLUSTRATIONS.CARD3-TEXT: The illustrations have a size of 13 x 18cm and we dedicate between 6 and 10 minutes per person. Therefore, depending on the number of attendees, it is recommended to adjust the total time accordingly.

BLOCK3.TITLE: HANDMADE ILLUSTRATIONS
BLOCK3.SUBTITLE: An unforgettable memory
BLOCK3.TEXT1: Each illustration has its own personality. The selected and hand-cut paper, high-quality colors, and small details make each piece special and unique.
BLOCK3.TEXT2: Because the best memories deserve something more than a photograph: a work created to preserve them.

BLOCK4.TITLE: DELIVERY AND PERSONALIZATION
BLOCK4.SUBTITLE: A memory that lasts
BLOCK4.TEXT1: The illustrations are delivered in a plastic sleeve. In this way, each guest takes it with them, protected for its conservation.
BLOCK4.TEXT2: If you wish, it is also possible to prepare the paper with your names and the date of the event or any other detail.

ILLUSTRATIONS.FRASE: The art is not something that can be taken and left. It is necessary for life

PAINTING.TITLE: PAINTINGS
PAINTING.SUBTITLE: Live painting sessions for weddings and events

BLOCK1.TITLE: A REAL-TIME PAINTING EXPERIENCE
BLOCK1.SUBTITLE: A moment transformed into art
BLOCK1.TEXT1: There are moments that deserve to become more than just a memory. The live painting allows you to capture the essence of a celebration through a pictorial work created during the event itself. Ideal for those couples who want something more special to remember their big day and their 'yes'.

BLOCK2.TITLE: THE CREATIVITY PROCESS
BLOCK2.SUBTITLE: A piece of art that is born during the celebration
BLOCK2.TEXT1: Your guests will be able to enjoy a unique show: the creation of a live painting, which will become an irreplaceable memory of your special day.

PAINTING.CARD1-TEXT: A side table with two chairs. In a very bright place and if it is outdoors, the table must be in the shade.
PAINTING.CARD2-TEXT: We stop at every detail. So it usually takes between 6 and 8 hours of work. Once completed, the artwork will be delivered to the couple on the same day of the event, ready to hang.
PAINTING.CARD3-TEXT: We bring all the necessary materials for the creation of the painting. Including the easel, paints and brushes.

BLOCK3.TITLE: AN IRREPLACEABLE PIECE
BLOCK3.SUBTITLE: A memory for a lifetime
BLOCK3.TEXT1: Unlike other memories of a celebration, a live painting is an original work, created especially for its protagonists.
BLOCK3.TEXT2: A piece that will be able to occupy a special place in their home and that, every time they contemplate it, will allow them to relive the emotion of that special day.

BLOCK4.TITLE: A FRAMED PAINTING
BLOCK4.SUBTITLE: Add elegance and elevate your painting
BLOCK4.TEXT1: To be able to deliver the painting that same day and in the best possible way, it will be delivered in a floating wooden frame and ready to hang.
BLOCK4.TEXT2: If you wish, it is also possible to prepare the most elegant frame or some other detail. Ask us about the available options at those moments and we will advise you on the best possible way.

PAINTING.FRASE: «The goal of art is not to represent the external appearance of things, but their internal meaning».

SILHOUETTES.TITLE: SILHOUETTES
SILHOUETTES.SUBTITLE: Victorian-style live silhouettes for weddings and events

BLOCK1.TITLE: AN ARTWORK WITH A STORY
BLOCK1.SUBTITLE: The elegance of a Victorian portrait
BLOCK1.TEXT1: Inspired by the traditional French profile portraits of the 18th century. The Victorian silhouettes, so popular in gatherings and parties, revive a way of portraying that is full of charm and personality.
BLOCK1.TEXT2: During the celebration, each guest becomes the protagonist of a small piece of art: their own profile transformed into a personalized and timeless memory.

BLOCK2.TITLE: LIVE ART
BLOCK2.SUBTITLE: A small portrait with a lot of history
BLOCK2.TEXT1: A different experience to surprise your guests and give them a memory made especially for them.

SILHOUETTES.CARD1-TEXT: Each guest poses briefly to capture the features and personality of their profile. To create a more realistic environment like the profiles made in the 18th century, we place a cloth for reference photos.
SILHOUETTES.CARD2-TEXT: To be able to work properly, we need a long table (if possible) with two chairs. It should be in a very bright place and if it's outdoors, the table should be in the shade.
SILHOUETTES.CARD3-TEXT: The silhouettes have a size of 10 x 15cm and we dedicate between 3 and 5 minutes per person. So depending on the number of attendees, it is recommended to adjust the total time accordingly.

BLOCK3.TITLE: A PERSONAL DETAIL
BLOCK3.SUBTITLE: A memory that speaks of each guest
BLOCK3.TEXT1: There are no two identical profiles. Each silhouette captures the features of a person and transforms them into a simple, elegant and character-filled portrait.
BLOCK3.TEXT2: An original alternative to traditional wedding details, perfect for those who want to surprise their guests with a different artistic experience.

BLOCK4.TITLE: CLASSIC · DELICATE · CUSTOMIZED
BLOCK4.SUBTITLE: The beauty of the timeless
BLOCK4.TEXT1: The Victorian silhouettes have something special: their simplicity allows one to recognize a person through just a few strokes. A small artistic piece that preserves the charm of another era.

SILHOUETTES.FRASE: «Art doesn't change anything, art changes you»

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.INTRO: Do you have any questions about Live Art, custom illustrations or how to make a booking? If you need any further information, I'll be happy to help.

BOOKING.TITLE: Bookings, Dates and Payments
BOOKING.Q1: How far in advance should I book a Live Art service?
BOOKING.A1: I recommend getting in touch as soon as you know your event date, especially if you're planning a wedding. Many celebrations are organised months in advance, and availability is limited. The sooner we talk, the more likely I am to be available to join you on your special day.
BOOKING.Q2: How do I reserve a date, and how much is the booking deposit?
BOOKING.A2: Once we've agreed on the service and you've received the quote, I'll explain the payment terms and the amount required to secure your date. The booking deposit is 20% of the total price. Your date is reserved once the agreed booking process has been completed. The deposit amount and specific terms will be included in your quote.
BOOKING.Q3: How can I request a quote?
BOOKING.A3: You can get in touch through the website contact form or by sending me a message. To prepare a quote tailored to your needs, I'll need to know the type of service you're interested in, the date and location, the approximate number of guests if it's an event, and any other details you think are important.

LIVEART.TITLE: Live Art at Weddings and Events
LIVEART.A1: Live Art involves creating illustrations or an artwork live during a celebration. It's an original way to turn a special occasion into a personalised keepsake and offer guests a unique artistic experience.
LIVEART.Q2: What types of Live Art can I book?
LIVEART.A2: Depending on the available options, you can choose guest portraits in watercolour or digital format, personalised illustrations, or a live painting of the couple. Each service has its own features, so we can discuss which option best suits your celebration.
LIVEART.Q3: What do I need to arrange for the event day?
LIVEART.A3: I'll need access to the venue at least one hour before the event to set up my workspace. I usually require a table, two chairs, good lighting and access to water. We'll confirm all the details in advance to make sure everything is ready when the celebration begins.
LIVEART.Q4: What happens if there isn't enough time to draw all the guests?
LIVEART.A4: The number of portraits I can create depends on the time booked, the format chosen and the pace of the event. If it's not possible to complete every portrait during the celebration, we'll agree on how to finish the remaining portraits and send them by post afterwards.

COMMISSIONS.TITLE: Custom Illustrations and Commissions
COMMISSIONS.Q1: Can I commission a personalised illustration as a gift?
COMMISSIONS.A1: Of course! Personalised illustrations are a special way to give someone a lasting memory. We can work from reference photos or combine several people from different photographs. We'll also discuss the format and style you have in mind so the artwork suits the occasion.
COMMISSIONS.Q2: How far in advance should I order an illustration?
COMMISSIONS.A2: Ideally, you should get in touch at least one month in advance, especially if you need the illustration for a specific date. This gives us time to organise the commission, create the artwork and arrange delivery if needed. The final timeframe will depend on the complexity of the piece and my availability.
COMMISSIONS.A2.1: For more realistic commissions, such as watercolour portraits or paintings on canvas, the turnaround time may be longer. I recommend checking availability and delivery times before placing your order. For these types of commissions, at least two months' notice is recommended.
COMMISSIONS.Q3: What photographs or information should I provide?
COMMISSIONS.A3: You can send me your photographs by email, WhatsApp, WeTransfer or another agreed method. Ideally, the images should be good quality and show the important details clearly. If you have any preferences regarding the composition or final result, feel free to let me know when requesting your quote.

MATERIALS.TITLE: Materials and Environmental Commitment
MATERIALS.Q1: What materials do you use for your illustrations?
MATERIALS.A1: I carefully select my materials to create high-quality, long-lasting artwork, including heavyweight watercolour paper and professional-grade paints. Depending on the project, I also use professional markers and other materials suited to the technique. The choice of materials depends on the format and requirements of each commission.
MATERIALS.A2: I aim to work responsibly by choosing local products where possible, supporting Spanish suppliers and selecting materials manufactured in Spain. I also try to minimise waste wherever possible and take care with the presentation and packaging of my artwork.

SHIPPING.TITLE: Production Times and Shipping
SHIPPING.Q1: How long does it take to create an illustration?
SHIPPING.A1: Production time depends on the number of people, the format, the level of detail and the technique chosen. When you request a quote, I'll provide an estimated timeframe tailored to your commission and the date you need it by.
SHIPPING.A2: Yes, we can arrange delivery of your illustrations to your chosen address. Shipping costs and delivery times depend on the destination, the shipping method and the details of your order. These will be confirmed before your commission is finalised. Shipping within Spain starts at €10, with tracking and an estimated delivery time of 2–4 days, depending on the destination. For international shipments, costs and delivery times may vary depending on the destination country.
SHIPPING.Q3: When should I order an illustration if I need it for a special date?
SHIPPING.A3: I recommend placing your order well in advance to allow enough time for both creating the artwork and shipping it. If it's a gift for a wedding or another special occasion, please let me know the date from the outset so we can assess what's possible.

INES.NAME: Inés Rivilla
INES.BIOGRAPHY1: Inés is the founder of RIVILLA art studio. She graduated from the Faculty of Fine Arts at the University of Seville and has extensive experience as a portrait artist. She has participated in numerous competitions and group and solo art exhibitions, showcasing her own work.
INES.BIOGRAPHY2: Her passion for art and creativity led her to found RIVILLA art studio, where she combines her artistic talent with the creation of unique experiences for her clients.

AROA.NAME: Aroa Álvarez
AROA.BIOGRAPHY1: Aroa is our artist, with a diploma in Illustration and Artistic Creation from the Professional Illustration School of Madrid. She has extensive experience working with various publishers in the field of children's illustration.
AROA.BIOGRAPHY2: She has been involved in weddings and events for over two years, creating personalized and unique illustrations for each occasion.
